import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { UserHttpService } from '../user-http.service'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { TicketsService } from '../services/tickets.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-user-login', templateUrl: './user-login.component.html', styleUrls: ['./user-login.component.css'] }) export class UserLoginComponent implements OnInit { public errmessage = undefined; constructor( private us: UserHttpService, private router: Router, private ticketsService : TicketsService ) { } ngOnInit() { } login(mail: string, password: string, remember: boolean) { this.us.login(mail, password, remember).subscribe({ next: (d) => { if(this.us.is_passenger()){ const pending = localStorage.getItem('pendingTicket'); const pendingLayover = localStorage.getItem('pendingLayoverTickets'); if (pending) { const ticketData = JSON.parse(pending); console.log("[DEBUG] post-login, parsed ticketData:", ticketData); this.ticketsService.addTickets(ticketData).subscribe({ next: () => { alert('Biglietto acquistato con successo dopo login!'); localStorage.removeItem('pendingTicket'); this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore post-login:', err); this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); // Naviga comunque } }); } else if(pendingLayover){ const [firstTicket, secondTicket] = JSON.parse(pendingLayover); console.log("[DEBUG] post-login, firstTicket:", firstTicket); console.log("[DEBUG] post-login, secondTicket:", secondTicket); this.ticketsService.addTickets(firstTicket).subscribe({ next: () => { this.ticketsService.addTickets(secondTicket).subscribe({ next: () => { alert('Entrambi i voli acquistati con successo dopo il login!'); localStorage.removeItem('pendingLayoverTickets'); this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore post-login secondo volo:', err); this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); } }); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Errore post-login primo volo:', err); this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); } }); } else { console.log("[DEBUG] post-login, nessun pending, navigo a dashboard") console.log('Login granted, calling router.navigate(/tickets)'); this.errmessage = undefined; this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); } } if(this.us.is_airline()){ console.log('Login granted, calling router.navigate(/airlines)'); this.errmessage = undefined; this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); } if(this.us.is_admin()){ console.log('Login granted, calling router.navigate(/airlines)'); this.errmessage = undefined; this.router.navigate(['/dashboard']); // TODO inserire la pagina per l'inserimento compagnie aeree } }, error: (err) => { console.log('Login error: ' + JSON.stringify(err)); this.errmessage = err.message; } }); } }
